# Next Story

> Next.js App Router marketing site driven by Storyblok blocks. Portfolio proof that editors own copy and structure in a headless CMS while developers own components, draft preview, and cache invalidation. In-app demo brand: Northline.

- Site: https://nextstory.marcopontili.com/
- Source: https://github.com/marcop135/next-story (MIT)
- Author: Marco Pontili, https://marcopontili.com

## Pages

- [Home](https://nextstory.marcopontili.com/): Northline demo landing page rendered from Storyblok blocks
- [How it works](https://nextstory.marcopontili.com/how-it-works): content model, draft preview, publish webhook, and cache tags, step by step
- [Blocks](https://nextstory.marcopontili.com/blocks): every Storyblok block on the site, labelled with its component name
- [Pricing](https://nextstory.marcopontili.com/pricing): demo pricing page from the same block contract
- [German home](https://nextstory.marcopontili.com/de): German routes served from Storyblok field-level translations
- [Privacy](https://nextstory.marcopontili.com/privacy): cookieless self-hosted Matomo, Vercel hosting
- [For agents](https://nextstory.marcopontili.com/for-agents): how agents read the site, discovery files, and what has no API

## Docs

- [Architecture](https://github.com/marcop135/next-story/blob/main/docs/architecture.md): request path, preview, webhook revalidation
- [Storyblok schema](https://github.com/marcop135/next-story/blob/main/docs/storyblok-schema.md): content model as code, seed stories, languages
- [Commands](https://github.com/marcop135/next-story/blob/main/docs/commands.md): local setup, tests, preview and webhook URLs
